Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have purchased this grill about 4 months ago and used it every other week on average. As a long time Weber user, quality of the components of this Spirit II meets expectations and delivers a very good grilling experience. I have used it mainly with grills and rotisserie with a Wi-Fi temperature control with great satisfaction, this is the 2 burner version and both cooking area and power came out well sized for 4/6 people. Cleaning the grill is very easy, definitely well designed in that perspective while areas of improvement might be looked at in the assembly and grill mobility. Assembly is quite a long process and took me some good 3 to 4 hours work so some sub-assembly could be worth being pursued and movement of the unit resulted to be pretty inconvenient when the propane tank is in place: tilting the unit over the two wheels with a full tank is not easy so moving the unit around is not a super easy maneuver.
Results.Title: Very good product and a few ideas for improvement

Thank you for your feedback. 

If the cooking grates aren't hot enough, food will stick, and you will likely never have a chance of searing properly or developing those amazing grill marks. Always preheat the grill on the highest setting first. Open the lid, turn up the heat, close the lid, and then let the cooking grate heat up for about ten minutes or until the lid thermometer reads 500° F (260° C).

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

I love my new Weber grill and wish I had bought it earlier.  It's large enough for a family of four, or for a party with ten or so people.  It's easy to use, the instructions for assembly are quite good, and someone who is a bit handy will probably have no problem assembling it.  It does come in many parts, but you won't need any technical know-how to put it together.  If you get frustrated with assembling Ikea products, you may want to hire someone.
Using the grill is a cinch.  Though pricy, I have also bought only Weber accessories.  I kinda think they are worth the money.  They are thoughtful designed and of very good quality

Results.ReviewText:
I have wanted a Weber for years, but they're pricey.  I finally broke down and bought one and assembled it myself.  For a small grill, the Spirit II E-210 feels sturdy and substantial and should last for many years.  It's easy to put together if you go slowly and pay attention.  I'm a 70 year old woman and I figure if I can put this little grill together by myself, almost anyone else can.  I've been using the grill now for a few weeks and the flavor bars make a big difference in the taste of foods!  Cleanup is easy and fast.  I love my new grill!  

On another note, when I first hooked up the regulator hose to the propane tank, there was a leak.  I called Weber and forwarded the info they requested.  Two days later a new hose and regulator was delivered to my back door.  At this point I had to get help to change out the hose because the fittings were so tight it took more strength than I had.  Ultimately it took two people to separate the hose, but when that was done, the rest was simple.
Results.Title: Spirit II E-210

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
